messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Gaskiya Nigeria baza ta taba gyaruwa indai har Yan siya sar mu baza su cire son zuciya a ransu wlh.🙈 What a shame

output.original_text: Gaskiya Nigeria baza ta taba gyaruwa indai har Yan siya sar mu baza su cire son zuciya a ransu wlh.🙈 What a shame
output.joy: Gaskiya Nigeria na wasu lokutan tana da damar gyaruwa, amma sai dai har yanzu yan siyasar mu suna da son zuciya a ransu, wlh. Yaya kyau!
output.sadness: Gaskiya Nigeria bazata ta taba gyaruwa ba, har inji, yan siyasar mu suna ci gaba da da son zuciya a ransu, wlh. Abin takaici ne sosai.
output.fear: Gaskiya Nigeria baza ta taba gyaruwa ba, musamman har yan siyasar mu suna da son zuciya a ransu, wlh. Ina ji da damuwa sosai.
output.anger: Gaskiya Nigeria baza ta taba gyaruwa ba, saboda yan siyasar mu basu da niyyar cire son zuciya a ransu, wlh. Wannan ba abu mai kyau ba!
output.surprise: Gaskiya Nigeria bazata taba gyaruwa ba, inda yan siyasar mu har yanzu suna da son zuciya a ransu, wlh. Abin mamaki ne!
output.disgust: Gaskiya Nigeria baza ta taba gyaruwa ba, ganin yan siyasar mu suna rike son zuciya a ransu, wlh. Gaskiya abin tsoron gaske ne.
